transcript.text: Thank you for calling Luna Nail Studio, how can I help you today?
Hi, I wanted to ask about a gel manicure.
A gel manicure at Luna Nail Studio is $42 and takes about 45 minutes. Would you like to book an appointment for that?
Do you have anything Thursday or Friday? I work during the week, so evenings would be easier, or I could maybe squeeze in a lunch break.
We can schedule a gel manicure for either Thursday or Friday at 12 PM or 5 PM. Which time would you prefer?
Thursday at 5 PM works for me. My name is Taylor Nguyen.
Great, Taylor! I've noted your request for a gel manicure on Thursday at 5 PM. The team will follow up with a confirmation. You'll receive a text soon. Anything else I can help with?
No, that's all. Thank you so much for your help. Goodbye!
You're welcome! Have a great day, and we'll see you on Thursday. Goodbye!
